note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997); original in English; soldiers and workers are both dimorphic, each treated in a single section; synonymy, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Major soldier body length 11.0–14.0 mm, head capsule broadly oval, widest at the middle, mandibles short and thick, about half as long as head; minor soldier mandibles slender, mandible/head length ratio 0.65–0.80; alate forewing length 27.0–28.0 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Major soldier: head capsule pale reddish brown to reddish brown; mandibles black; thorax rusty yellow; abdomen pale brown to brown; legs rusty yellow. Head and body very sparsely pilose. Body length 11.0–14.0 mm. Head capsule large, broadly oval; widest near the middle, strongly narrowed anteriorly (length to mandibular base 4.10–4.85 mm, maximum width 3.60–4.15 mm, width/length ratio 0.855–0.90, width at mandibular base/maximum width ratio about 0.566–0.590). Fontanelle small, circular, at the middle of the head. Compound eyes pale spots, slightly raised. Ocelli indistinct. Antennae 17-segmented; segment 3 much longer than segment 2; segment 4 slightly longer than segment 2. Labrum oval, ligulate, with a triangular translucent point at the apex. Mandibles short and thick, about half the head length (length 2.20–2.40 mm, mandible/head length ratio 0.49–0.53). Postmentum subquadrate, slightly wider posteriorly (length 2.90–3.10 mm, maximum width 1.10–1.25 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 1.26–1.60 mm, width 2.60–2.93 mm); anterior margin weakly concave, posterior margin distinctly concave. Minor soldier: colour and pilosity as in the major soldier. Body length 7.20–9.0 mm. Head capsule oval (length to mandibular base 2.20–2.96 mm, maximum width 1.88–2.51 mm); sides strongly narrowed anteriorly (width at mandibular base/maximum width ratio 0.584–0.625). Antennae 17-segmented; segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2; segment 4 as long as segment 2; segment 5 shorter than segment 4. Labrum triangular, ligulate, with a triangular translucent point at the apex. Mandibles slender, apex slightly incurved (length 1.50–1.60 mm, mandible/head length ratio 0.65–0.80). Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.88–1.05 mm, maximum width 1.48–1.86 mm); anterior margin without a concavity, posterior margin distinctly incised.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dimorphic. Major worker: head pale brown, anterior part yellowish; thorax yellowish brown; abdominal tergites pale yellowish brown, sternites paler. Head and body sparsely pilose. Body length about 7.0 mm. Head circular (length to apex of labrum 2.5–2.7 mm, length to mandibular base 1.80–1.90 mm, maximum width 2.15–2.20 mm). Fontanelle round and large. Compound eyes whitish spots, slightly raised. Antennae 18–19-segmented; segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 2 longer than segment 4 (in the 18-segmented antennae); in the 19-segmented antennae segment 3 shorter than segment 2 and segment 2 as long as segment 4. Postclypeus less than half as long as wide. Pronotum with anterior margin not concave and posterior margin distinctly incised (length 0.38–0.40 mm, width 0.95–1.00 mm). Minor worker: paler and smaller than the major worker, antennae 17-segmented; segment 3 shorter than segment 2 and nearly as long as segment 4. Body length 5.5 mm, maximum head width 1.41 mm, maximum pronotum width 0.87 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown to blackish brown; antennae, labrum and legs rusty yellow; postclypeus paler than head; wings transparent, very pale yellow; dorsal abdomen dark brown, ventral abdomen brown with a paler middle. Head and body sparsely pilose, wings more densely pilose. Body length with wings 32.0–33.0 mm, without wings 11.4–17.0 mm. Head subcircular, flattened (length to mandibular base 1.8–2.10 mm, width including compound eyes 2.70–2.93 mm). Fontanelle small, very slightly raised. Compound eyes medium-sized (maximum diameter 0.83 mm), protruding. Ocelli elliptical, large (major diameter 0.35 mm, minor diameter 0.20 mm), separated from the compound eye by about their minor diameter (0.18 mm). Antennae 19-segmented; segment 3 longer than segment 2. Postclypeus inflated, length about half its width. Pronotum nearly as wide as head or slightly narrower (length 1.30–1.62 mm, width 2.60–2.88 mm); anterior and posterior margins both distinctly concave. Wings long, transparent, rather densely pilose; micropilosity between costa and radius in 20–25 rows, 6–7 rows on the posterior margin; membrane without cuticular rods; forewing length 27.0–28.0 mm.
